fields.Brand Customer Promise: An upscale stay that feels attainable: curated little luxuries, spa-inspired bathrooms, space to work and unwind, and local touches—from craft beer to rooftop views—that reward guests who are going places.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Approachable indulgence on the road—everything needed for productive travel plus small, curated moments they cannot find elsewhere.

Owners: Grow in key markets with an upscale brand value-engineered for performance, with framework flexibility to create a unique sense of place within proven design and operations.

Choice: Upscale by Choice—reliability, distribution, dedicated upscale support, and procurement and revenue tools that fuel owner success.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Approachable indulgence — curated small luxuries and attainable finer touches on the road.

Upscale by Choice — dedicated upscale support, technology, distribution, and education through the Choice network.

Unique sense of place — developer thumbprint within a design framework optimized for operations, financial performance, and guest appeal.

The Cambria guest — driven, discerning professionals who invest in quality experiences.
fields.Brand History: Cambria Hotels is an upscale brand from Choice Hotels, now open across top U.S. markets and expanding coast to coast. Each property is designed for an experience that is approachable yet sophisticated, with little luxuries that make a meaningful difference for travelers—and value-engineered performance for owners.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: The Cambria guest is striving for personal and professional success, treats their role as a career, and is selective about brands because they know the service level they expect. They seek value on everyday items but will indulge on experiences that matter—earning small badges of indulgence on the road.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Approachable indulgence — open lobby workspaces, fitness, chic bars, spacious rooms, spa-inspired baths, Bluetooth mirrors, premium amenities, and location-specific rooftop and local craft touches.

Owner flexibility — proven upscale structure with room for a unique sense of place and developer thumbprint.

Choice upside support — award-winning education, industry-leading technology, procurement, revenue optimization, and distribution through Choice Privileges and global sales.
